events.title: Izumo Taisha Grand Shrine
events.description: One of Japan’s oldest Shinto shrines, dedicated to Ōkuninushi and famed for its giant shimenawa rope. Stroll the sacred approach, Haiden and Kagura-den.

events.title: Inasa-no-Hama Beach & Bentenjima
events.description: Sacred shoreline west of the shrine where deities are welcomed during Kamiarizuki; iconic Benten-jima rock and famous sunsets.

events.title: Hinomisaki Lighthouse & Coast
events.description: Historic lighthouse on the Shimane Peninsula with dramatic sea cliffs and top sunset views; near Hinomisaki Shrine.
